messages.subject: [IT] Document management system maintenance - Saturday 15 November
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear all,

The DMS will be unavailable from 20:00 on Saturday 15 November until approximately 02:00 Sunday for scheduled maintenance and indexing upgrades. Please save and close any open documents before 20:00. Email will be unaffected.

Thanks,
IT Helpdesk
